description: "Christian Marriage Indissoluble: A Plain Sermon" by James Galloway Cowan is a religious sermon published in the mid-19th century, specifically in 1857. This work serves as a theological treatise delivering a staunch defense of the indissolubility of Christian marriage, countering legislative proposals that would allow for divorce and remarriage under certain conditions.
